blocks.x: Game Of Thrones: The Radiant Conqueror Announced For Dragonfire

Tom Wilson is a Gaming Features Writer at Screen Rant. Over the past five years, Tom has worked as the Editor-in-Chief at The Game Crater, as a Staff Writer for GamingIntel, a List Writer at TheGamer, and, of course, as a Senior Writer at ScreenRant. Tom has experience writing reviews, guides, news, and features, and has been responsible for teams of writers, training them and editing their work.
Tom graduated with a Masters in Multimedia Journalism, and has since gone on to build up his portfolio of games journalism work.

Game of Thrones' many ongoing projects beyond the books and shows have all proven to be rather successful or have been warmly received. Of course, this is, in part, thanks to the goodwill generated by the aforementioned books and shows, but is also due to the fact that, at least for the most part, Warner Bros. has stepped up its game when it comes to licensed Game of Thrones projects. We're finally starting to see and hear about exciting new titles that befit a series of this magnitude and fame.

Among these projects is the next massive upcoming GOT video game, War for Westeros, which finally gives the series the grand strategy game it deserves. However, perhaps the most popular among the ongoing Game of Thrones releases is Dragonfire, a title that has managed to amass millions of fans despite only being released a short while ago. Its success is partially due to its steady stream of updates, chief among them being the brand-new The Radiant Conqueror that existing fans and newcomers alike will absolutely want to check out.

Game of Thrones: Dragonfire, for those who aren't aware, is a mobile strategy game centered around, rather unsurprisingly, dragons. Designed to tie in with the latest season of House of the Dragon, Dragonfire launched with 28 unique dragons for players to collect and has slowly been adding to them ever since. The very best dragons in Dragonfire offer incredible bonuses to players and are instrumental in winning the game's battles, so it's always worth paying attention whenever a new one is added.

The Radiant Conqueror, Kalspire, is the latest dragon to be added to Dragonfire. It is a completely original dragon, one not featured in the House of the Dragon show, that looks set to be a fine addition worthy of being added to players' collections. Prioritizing debuffing the enemy through assorted status effects, Bleed, and Panic, Kalspire is designed around suppressing your opponent's forces rather than necessarily dealing a lot of damage. This Legendary Champion thrives against concentrated forces, his abilities affecting adjacent enemies in addition to his original target. His official description reads:

Kalspire is a strong and resolute Champion who turns repeated Basic Attacks into layered Tactical and Physical pressure while spreading debilitating status effects across adjacent enemies. He brings constant pressure with persistent Bleed and Panic application, and targeted suppression of key offensive threats.

Kalspire is a Legendary Champion, which makes obtaining him a tad difficult. Like with any other dragon in Dragonfire, you'll need to find his Dragon Relics before summoning him in the Dragon Pit. This process can be made easier through purchasing in-game resources, but it isn't impossible to do for free. You'll just need to grind away at daily activities, event stages, and personal chapters to unlock premium Hatchery chests.

Dragonfire will only continue to get bigger with even more dragons for players to collect. It frequently gets a steady stream of updates featuring new Champions, balancing patches, and quality-of-life fixes, which constantly give players a reason to return. If Kalspire doesn't quite fit into your strategy, there will almost certainly be another dragon added soon that does. For now, Kalspire is a welcome addition to Game of Thrones: Dragonfire, and a good indication that its developer, Warner Bros. Games Boston, knows how to hatch a compelling original dragon.
